claims: Brad Underwood is the head men's basketball coach at the University of Illinois.
Brad Underwood has held the position of head men's basketball coach at the University of Illinois since 2017.
Brad Underwood has led the Fighting Illini to three Big Ten titles.
Brad Underwood has led the Fighting Illini to multiple NCAA Tournament appearances.
Brad Underwood led the Fighting Illini to the Elite Eight in 2024.
Brad Underwood is the Richmond Family Endowed Men's Head Basketball Coach.
Brad Underwood has secured over 80 Big Ten wins during his tenure.
Brad Underwood is the 2021 Big Ten Tournament Champion.
Brad Underwood is the 2024 Big Ten Tournament Champion.
Brad Underwood is the 2022 Big Ten Regular Season Champion.
Orlando Antigua is Associate Head Coach on the 2025-26 coaching staff.
Geoff Alexander is on the 2025-26 coaching staff.
Tyler Underwood is on the 2025-26 coaching staff.
Camryn Crocker is on the 2025-26 coaching staff.
Shauna Green is the head coach of the Illinois Fighting Illini women's basketball team.
